keybinding.toggleHint: Opens or closes the DM Helper window

notifications.safeRestReset: Safe Rest: {name}'s resources have been reset
notifications.newDayReset: New Day: daily abilities have been reset
notifications.safeRestAllReset: Safe Rest: rest abilities have been reset for all characters
notifications.dropNotCharacter: Only player characters can be dropped here

settings.playerAccessHint: Allow players to use the helper window. Players will only see their own character, while the GM sees all characters.
settings.showToolbarButtonHint: Display a button in the token controls to open DM Helper
settings.compactModeHint: Use a more compact display with smaller elements and hidden controls
settings.showAbilitiesHint: Display class abilities section on character cards
settings.showDeleteAbilityHint: Display a delete button on abilities to remove them from the character
settings.showRollButtonHint: Display a roll button on dice pools to roll and add a die
settings.showClearButtonHint: Display a clear button on dice pools to remove all dice
settings.showDicePoolMaxHint: Display the maximum number of dice next to dice pool abilities
settings.mergedBarsHint: Combine the label and value with the resource bar on a single line for HP and Mana. Hides temporary HP when enabled.
settings.showBarControlsHint: Display +/- buttons on resource bars (HP, Mana, etc.) to adjust values
settings.woundsOnlyAtZeroHPHint: Only display the wounds tracker when a character has 0 hit points
settings.filterByPresenceHint: Only show characters of connected players who have them set as main character
settings.persistPinnedActorsHint: When enabled, characters added via drag and drop are saved across sessions. When disabled, they are only kept for the current session.
